clauses.standard_text: Employee agrees not to engage in directly competitive employment within a 25-mile radius of Company offices for a period of 6 months following termination.

Employee assigns to Company inventions created during employment, on Company time, or using Company resources. Inventions made on personal time without Company resources remain the property of Employee.
Company may terminate for cause defined as gross misconduct, breach of confidentiality, or material policy violation, with written notice and opportunity to cure where applicable.
Either party may terminate this agreement upon two (2) weeks' written notice.
Upon termination without cause, Employee shall receive two (2) weeks' severance per year of service.
Employee shall hold Company confidential information in strict confidence during and for 3 years after employment.
